Facilities

🅿️ Free Parking

Ample free on-site parking is available for all shoppers. The car park is accessible directly from Delama Boulevard with clearly marked bays including accessible parking near the main entrance.

⚡ EV Charging

Six dedicated electric vehicle charging bays are available in the main car park. Check in-centre signage for location details.

🛝 Outdoor Playground

A dedicated outdoor playground for children is located adjacent to the dining precinct — a great spot for families to enjoy while dining or after shopping.

🍽️ Outdoor Dining Plaza

Our covered outdoor dining precinct on the east side of the centre provides a relaxed al fresco setting to enjoy meals from our variety of dining outlets.

🚗 Car Wash

An on-site car wash facility is available for shoppers to use while they browse the centre.
